title: Maja Bjeljac — hover a category and the page fills with it
note: On /foto/ three square tiles sit in a row on white, each labelled in lowercase Druk Wide Bold (37–63px, white #F8F8F8, line-height 1.05) hanging off the tile's left edge. Hovering a tile's image fades in that category's own photos around it on opacity 0.2s, each in its own arrangement: 'artist photography' becomes one full-bleed concert photo, 'portrait' a 4-panel mosaic filling the screen, 'personal projects' a scattered overlapping collage. Worth reusing: preview the category itself rather than a thumbnail, with a different arrangement per category. Closest kit blocks are reach-index and work-index, but neither fills the whole page.
